day_local: Jimcaha Toddobaadka Labaatan iyo Shanaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso. Masiixow, noo naxariiso. Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
homily:
Waxaa jira waxyaabo yaryar oo nolosha qofka ka dhiga mid macno leh, waxyaabo aan inta badan iska indho-tirno illaa ay xilligoodu dhaafaan. Waxaan maanta maskaxdayda ku hayaa sawirka Ben oo si taxaddar leh u dhex socda garoonka diyaaradaha, isagoo indhihiisa waaweyn ee wax-raadiyaha ah ku eegaya diyaaradaha Boeing 737 ee ku sii jeeda cirka. Ma ahayn kaliya xiiso uu u qabay mashiinnada; waxay ahayd xiiso uu u qabay dunida ballaadhan ee uu Ilaah abuuray. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay inuu wax walba u arko sida qurux, sida fursad, iyo sida waddo uu ku gaari karo wax ka sarreeya xuduudaha dhulka. 

Akhriska koowaad ee maanta, oo ka yimid Kitaabka Qohaleed, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Wax walba waxaa u leh waqti go'an, iyo wax kasta oo samada hoosteeda ah waxaa u leh waqti.' Qoraagu wuxuu inoo sawirayaa wareegga nolosha: waqti la beero iyo waqti la goosto, waqti la ooyo iyo waqti la qoslo. Markaan eegno nolosha Ben, oo ahayd mid gaaban laakiin aad u qoto dheer, waxaan dareemeynaa in saacadaha dunidu ay u muuqdaan kuwo aan sinnayn. Waxaan is-weydiinnaa: 'Muxuu waqtiga Ben u gaabnaaday? Maxaynu u dhex fadhiisannaa aamusnaan aan la filayn?' Laakiin Kitaabku wuxuu inoo xusuusinayaa in Ilaah uu 'wax walba qurux u yeelay xilligooda.' Tani ma aha mid inoo sahlaysa inaan fahanno xanuunka, laakiin waxay inoo sheegaysaa in nolosha Ben aysan ahayn mid khasaartay. Waxay ahayd nolol dhammaystiran, nolol uu Ilaah u qorsheeyay waqti gaar ah oo uu ku iftiimiyo qalbiyadeenna.

Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa Ciise oo xertiisa weydiinaya: 'Dadku waxay leeyihiin anigu kuman baan ahay?' Kadibna wuxuu u soo jeestay iyaga: 'Idinkuse kuman baad leedihiin inaan ahay?' Ciise wuxuu rabay inuu ogaado haddii ay fahamsan yihiin cidda uu yahay ka hor inta uusan u sheegin inuu 'waajib ku yahay inuu aad u xanuunsado oo la diido.' Tani waa xuddunta iimaankeena. Masiixu wuxuu dhex galay xanuunka aadanaha si uu u beddelo. Markaad maanta dareemaysaan culayska, Alan iyo Thao, markaad xusuusanaysaan Ben oo ku leh 'Good morning, Dad,' ama markaad Ryan xusuusanaysaan wada-socodkiinnii, ogow in Ciise uu dhex fadhiisto xanuunkaas. Wuxuu yaqaan macnaha la diido, macnaha la xanuunsado, iyo macnaha la lumiyo qof aad jeceshahay.

Waxaan rabaa inaan si gaar ah ula hadlo waalidiinta. Waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ay dareemayeen sida buur culus oo saaran xabadka. Waxaan ogahay in habeenkii, marka aad eegto sawirrada Ben, aad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta dhex fadhiisto xanuunkaas idinkala socda oo aan idiin sheego si cad: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Xanuunka iyo dhimashada aan la fileynin ee soo martay Ben ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Jacaylka aad Ben siisateen—sheekooyinkii, safarradii, iyo xanaanadii aad u haysay—wuxuu ahaa nuurka dhabta ah ee noloshiisa. Ha isku dayin inaad xalliso xanuunkaaga adigoo isticmaalaya xisaabtaada. Ha isku dayin inaad fahanto sababta uu Ben u baxay. Kaliya u dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise.

Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay inuu bixiyo. Xusuuso markuu ahaa 15 sano jir, ee uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabay inuu siiyo dhammaan lacagta sanduuqiisa yar si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanayd. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas safka hore kaga jiray ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa xigmadda dhabta ah ee Masiixu inoo sheegayo. Taasi waa jacayl aan xisaab lahayn, jacayl aan sugin mahadcelin, jacayl si fudud u bixiya naftiisa. Ben wuxuu baray qoyskiisa in jacaylku aanu ahayn waxa aad haysato, laakiin waa waxa aad diyaar u tahay inaad bixiso. 

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in dunidaadu ay isbeddeshay. Waxaan ogahay in kursiga agtaada ah uu mararka qaarkood u muuqdo mid madhan. Laakiin xusuuso, Ben wuxuu kula joogaa jacaylka aad u hayso. Sida uu kuugu sheegay riyadaada, halkaas oo aad ku wada raacdeen 'roller coaster', xidhiidhka idinka dhexeeya wuu sii socdaa. Ha ka cabsan inaad noolaato, ha ka cabsan inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdo. 

Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan maanta, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada marka culaysku yimaado. U dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise. Ha joojiso inaad is-eedeyso. Ogow in Ben uu ku jiro nabadda iyo gacmaha Aabbaha, oo uu halkaas idinku sugayo. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay meel nabdoon, wuxuuna idin leeyahay: 'Haku murugoonina si xad dhaaf ah; waan idin daawanayaa.' Ha iloobin in jacaylka Ben uu weli ku nool yahay adduunkan. Sida ceelka biyaha ee Cà Mau, ee uu magaciisa ku qoran yahay, jacaylkiisu wuxuu u socdaa dadka harraadsan, isagoo u keenaya nolol iyo rajo. Sidaas oo kale, qalbiyadiinna ha u furnaadaan rajo cusub. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciisow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa codsanayaa inaad qalbigayga soo gasho, maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin si muuqata. Igu soo biir, oo igu hay midnimadaada, si aanan marnaba kaaga fogaan. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabad weligeed ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Ben iyo dhammaan dadka dhintay, inuu Rabbigu siiyo nabad iyo iftiin weligeed ah, waxaan Rabbiga ka baryaynaa.
Qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa xanuunka haya, inuu Ilaah ku xoojiyo rajo iyo naxariis, waxaan Rabbiga ka baryaynaa.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Wax walba waxaa u leh waqti go'an, iyo wax kasta oo samada hoosteeda ah waxaa u leh waqti. Waqti la dhalo, iyo waqti la dhinto; waqti la beero, iyo waqti la rujiyo wax la beeray. Waqti la dilo, iyo waqti la bogsiiyo; waqti la dumiyo, iyo waqti la dhiso. Waqti la ooyo, iyo waqti la qoslo; waqti la baroorto, iyo waqti la cayaaro. Waqti dhagax la tuuro, iyo waqti dhagax la ururiyo; waqti la isku duubo, iyo waqti laga fogaado is-duubista. Waqti la raadiyo, iyo waqti la lumiyo; waqti la xajisto, iyo waqti la tuuro. Waqti la jeexjeexo, iyo waqti la tolo; waqti la aamuso, iyo waqti la hadlo. Waqti la jeclaado, iyo waqti la neceb yahay; waqti dagaal, iyo waqti nabad. Maxay faa'iido u leedahay hawl-wadeenka hawshiisu? Waxaan fiiriyey hawsha Ilaah u dhiibay binu-aadmiga inay ku mashquulaan. Wax walba wuxuu u yeelay kuwo qurux badan xilligooda, wuxuuna weligeednimada geliyey qalbiyadooda, iyadoon binu-aadmigu ogaan karin, bilow ilaa dhammaad, hawsha Ilaah sameeyey.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Rabbiga, Dhagaxayga, ha la ammaano! Rabbiga, dhagaxayga, naxariistayda iyo qalcaddayda, munaaraddayda iyo badbaadiyahayga, gaashankayga, kan aan ku kalsoonahay. R. Rabbiga, Dhagaxayga, ha la ammaano! Rabbiyow, waa maxay binu-aadmiga inaad u fiirsato, iyo wiilka binu-aadmiga inaad ka fikirto? Binu-aadmigu wuxuu la mid yahay neef, maalmihiisuna waxay la mid yihiin hooska dhaafaya. R. Rabbiga, Dhagaxayga, ha la ammaano!

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Mar Ciise keligiis tukanayay, xertiisiina ay la joogeen, ayuu weydiiyey, 'Dadku waxay leeyihiin anigu kuman baan ahay?' Waxay ugu jawaabeen, 'Yooxanaa Baabtiisaha; qaar kale waxay leeyihiin Eliiyaah; qaarna waxay leeyihiin mid ka mid ah nebiyadii hore ayaa soo sara kacay.' Markaasuu wuxuu ku yidhi, 'Idinkuse kuman baad leedihiin inaan ahay?' Butros wuxuu ugu jawaabay, 'Masiixa Ilaah.' Wuu u digay, wuxuuna ku amray inaanay cidna u sheegin. Wuxuu yidhi, 'Wiilka Aadmiga waa inuu aad u xanuunsadaa, waana in odayaasha, wadaaddada sare iyo culimada ay diidaan, waana in la dilaa, maalinta saddexaadna waa in la sara kiciyaa.'

day: Friday of the Twenty-fifth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
